checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Face, features and expression are identical in structure to the source.

must.item: Curly dark hair, sweater, head-and-shoulders framing retained
must.why: Framing and sweater are the same. The hair has shifted to a reddish-brown tint from the warm grade but is still dark and curly.
Trees, path, grass and bench are all in place with autumn-toned colours.

must.item: Warm faded grading and visible grain give 1970s film look
must.why: Strong orange/amber cast with a faded look. Grain is present but fairly subtle.
The image is square with no text.

faults.what: The orange cast is heavy. Skin looks sunburnt and the hair has turned reddish-brown, which makes it a little less true to her.
Grain is subtle, and the look reads more as a colour filter than a true faded 70s film.

summary: The output is a warm, orange-toned 1970s-style version that keeps her face, hair, sweater and park intact. The grade is slightly heavy and the grain mild.
